name: Create a blank project and switch floors
description: Verifies the new project starts empty with the requested plot dimensions and floor navigation.
steps: Choose Blank project on the welcome screen
Enter a project name, plot dimensions, and two floors
Create the project and switch to First Floor
expected: The editor opens with no rooms or furniture, shows the defined plot boundary, and switches between floor tabs.

name: Add a room and edit its exact dimensions
description: Verifies a room can be added and its dimensions can be edited from the inspector.
steps: Use the plus button to add a bedroom
Change its length and breadth in the properties panel
expected: The selected room appears on the canvas and its geometry updates to match the entered dimensions.

name: Search and place furniture
description: Verifies the searchable library inserts an editable furniture object.
steps: Create a blank project and open the plus menu
Search for a desk and add Study desk
expected: The desk appears on the active floor and can be selected and resized.

name: Export a plan and retain the local draft
description: Verifies the project is saved locally and both project-file and PDF-print workflows are available.
steps: Create a project and add a room
Choose Download editable project and then Print / Save as PDF
expected: A Hearthplan JSON project file downloads and the browser print dialog can be used to save a PDF.

name: Use a community template copy and validate setup
description: Verifies the community flow remains usable on mobile and invalid project setup is rejected.
steps: Open Community Templates from the welcome screen
If a local template exists, choose Use this template
Open Blank project and try to create a project with zero plot length
expected: A template opens as a separate project, and invalid plot dimensions trigger a validation message.
